tasks.name: 提取剧情总结
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
(async () => {
    const storeMod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/data/store.js');
    const ctx = (window.SillyTavern?.getContext)?.() ?? (await import('/scripts/extensions.js')).getContext();
    const chatId = ctx?.chatId;
    if (!chatId) { window.toastr?.error('当前没有打开聊天'); return; }

    const store = storeMod.getSummaryStore();
    if (!store) { window.toastr?.error('无法读取总结存储'); return; }

    const backup = {
        type: 'LittleWhiteBoxStorySummaryFullBackup',
        exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        chatId,
        storySummary: structuredClone(store),  // 整个大字段
    };

    const fileName = `story-summary-${String(chatId).replace(/[^\w\-.]+/g, '_')}.json`;
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(backup, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url; a.download = fileName;
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);

    console.log('[提取] 完成 | 事件:', store.json?.events?.length ?? 0, '| 文件:', fileName);
    window.toastr?.success(`✅ 剧情总结已提取 → ${fileName}`);
})();
<</taskjs>>
